dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Commanders (4-5-1) Week 12 Briefing: Wednesday Injury Report Ahead of Cardinals
bullets: Roster & Front Office: Washington signed WR Brandon Aiyuk and CB Ambry Thomas to the practice squad [Washington Commanders](https://x.com/Commanders/status/2125998013478998466).

Injury & Practice Status: WR Treylon Burks (foot) and DE Charles Omenihu (ribs) logged limited practice reps Wednesday [Scott Bair](https://www.hogshaven.com/washington-commanders-news/457325/washington-commanders-sign-brandon-aiyuk-practice-squad-49ers-espn). CB Amik Robertson (ankle) did not practice Wednesday, while QB Jayden Daniels (cleared — no designation) and LB Sonny Styles (cleared — no designation) practiced in full [Washington Commanders](https://x.com/Commanders/status/2125720796861698355).

Week 12 Cardinals Outlook: Dan Quinn and DC Daronte Jones open installation for the Arizona Cardinals (3-8, WSH -6.5, HC Mike LaFleur, OC Nathaniel Hackett & DC Nick Rallis (Road Test)) as Washington prepares for a pivotal NFC matchup [Scott Jennings](https://www.hogshaven.com/pressers/457459/david-blough-daronte-jones-talk-cardinals-qbs-win-over-bengals-brandon-aiyuk) [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/preview?gameId=401873092).

NFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 4-5-1 (3rd in NFC East • #11 Seed in NFC), Washington carries a 15.2% postseason projection, 14% NFC East division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/nfc-notes-cam-skattebo-brandon-aiyuk-joe-milton-commanders-eagles-giants/).

Statistical Profile & Matchup Edge: Through Week 11, Washington ranks #19 in Points / Game (21.8), #20 in Points Allowed / Game (24.3), #3 in Turnover Differential (+7), giving Dan Quinn and Daronte Jones a clear benchmark ahead of Sun, Nov 29, 4:25 PM EST • NFL TV at [object Object] against the Arizona Cardinals [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/nfc-notes-cam-skattebo-brandon-aiyuk-joe-milton-commanders-eagles-giants/).

Blough called Daniels' last two throws: "As good as it gets."
"The first one was a now or never throw, staring right down the barrel into a tight window...Then he drilled the second one. Antonio ran a great route. If you watch our practice clips of that play you'd have no doubt that Jayden and Antonio would have hooked up on those connections."
Blough also credited: Diggs for pulling the S out of the play and Okonkwo for attaching to the underneath defenders, clearing the path. And, of course, the protection.
"Just a glimpse of what we want to build on," Blough said.

rawStream.fullText:
GM Adam Peters, during his paid weekly appearance with the @junksradio, on Brandon Aiyuk:

"One of the things that I don't think anyone can dispute is his work ethic. He was one of the hardest workers on the team. That's how he became an All-Pro type player... The last season I was there he had a fantastic season. He was a true No. 1 receiver at the time. He's a guy who's a tough cover, he's great after the catch. There's a lot of great things about him on the field and he worked really hard to get there. It wasn't just that he was the most gifted guy; he's self made too. There's a lot of positives. One thing that stands out to me is his work ethic."

Peters also called him a "smart football player." Said he hasn't talked to him since leaving. Also said there's a difference between being in shape and "football shape" so IF signed, will adjust expectations accordingly.
